stem.x: For integers x and y (x > y ≥ 0), a function F(x, y) is defined as below:

stem.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 520 110" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g font-family="serif" font-size="20" fill="#222"><text x="20" y="62"><tspan font-style="italic">F</tspan>(<tspan font-style="italic">x</tspan>, <tspan font-style="italic">y</tspan>) =</text><text x="170" y="40"><tspan font-style="italic">x</tspan></text><text x="170" y="86"><tspan font-style="italic">F</tspan>(<tspan font-style="italic">y</tspan>, <tspan font-style="italic">x</tspan> mod <tspan font-style="italic">y</tspan>)</text><text x="350" y="40">(when <tspan font-style="italic">y</tspan> = 0)</text><text x="350" y="86">(when <tspan font-style="italic">y</tspan> > 0)</text></g><path d="M162,14 Q150,14 150,26 L150,46 Q150,56 140,56 Q150,56 150,66 L150,86 Q150,98 162,98" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>
stem.alt: Piecewise definition: F(x, y) = x (when y = 0); F(x, y) = F(y, x mod y) (when y > 0).

stem.x: What is the value F(231, 15)? Here, “x mod y” represents the remainder after division of x by y.
